newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Oil product throughput rises sharply in Rotterdam.
newsitem.headline: Oil product throughput rises sharply in Rotterdam.

text.p: Oil product flows in Rotterdam grew by 38 percent in the first half of the year making it the biggest growth sector in the port, the Rotterdam port authority said on Tuesday.
Imports rose by 47 percent to 6.1 million tonnes, with notable rises in the arrivals of diesel from the former Soviet Union countries and of gasoline from Kuwait.
Exports were up 23 percent to 3.1 million tonnes, mainly because of higher shipments to the United States.
The port noted a steady shift from heavy products to light products.
Crude imports were 3.4 percent below the level of last year, but the 48.4 million tonnes in the first half of 1997 was the second highest level of the last 10 years.
Crude imports also remain the largest individual cargo flow passing through Rotterdam.
